title: ArcMesh MCP Server Manifest
description: Describes an MCP server in the ArcMesh registry.

name.description: Unique server identifier — lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens only.

version.description: Semantic version of this manifest entry (e.g. 1.0.0).

description.description: One- or two-sentence plain-English summary of what the server does.

name.description: Display name of the person or organisation that maintains the server.

verified.description: True when the ArcMesh team has confirmed the publisher's identity.

install.description: How to install the server runtime.

type.description: Package manager / runtime used to run the server.

package.description: Package identifier (npm package, PyPI name, Docker image, download URL, etc.).

config.description: Runtime command and arguments written into the client config block.

command.description: Executable to invoke (npx, python, uvx, docker, etc.).

args.description: Ordered arguments passed to the command. Use ${VAR_NAME} placeholders for user-supplied values.

env.description: Environment variables the server reads at runtime. Keys are variable names.

description.description: Human-readable explanation shown in the installer UI.

required.description: Whether the variable must be set before the server can start.

default.description: Default value if the user does not supply one. Null means no default.

secret.description: True for passwords, tokens, and keys — the installer will mask the input.

clients.description: MCP clients known to work with this server.

permissions.description: Coarse-grained capability categories the server requires.

source_url.description: Canonical link to the server's source code.

license.description: SPDX license identifier (e.g. MIT, Apache-2.0, GPL-3.0-only).
